name: io.github.imtayyab2/loyverse-mcp
title: Loyverse
description: Read and manage a Loyverse POS account: catalogue, stock, customers, receipts and sales reports.

environmentVariables.name: LOYVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Loyverse access token, from the back office under Settings > Access tokens. Grants full access to the account.

environmentVariables.name: LOYVERSE_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the Loyverse API host. Defaults to https://api.loyverse.com/v1.0

environmentVariables.name: LOYVERSE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.
